name: Aditya Jaiswal
title: Full-Stack & Mobile Developer
tagline: I build production software end-to-end — web, mobile, and the backend wiring between them.
bio: I'm a BCA student and full-stack developer who ships complete products — not just demos. My recent work spans a real-time multiplayer game across three platforms, an AI-powered interview simulator, and a production app delivered to a paying client.
My stack centers on MERN and Flutter, with Docker and Git holding the workflow together. I'm currently exploring applied machine learning to bring intelligence into the products I build.
I care about the gap between 'it works on my machine' and 'it works in production' — that gap is most of the job, and it's the part I enjoy most.
